2117132775782220141.en_summary: Lyn Alden explains her family history: half from Mayflower Aldens, half German Schwarzwalders changed to Schwartzer at Ellis Island, meaning darker, and she is Lyn Alden of the Black Forest who discards nothing.
2117132775782220141.zh_summary: Lyn Alden解釋她的家族歷史：一半來自五月花號的Alden家族，一半是德國Schwarzwalders在埃利斯島被改為Schwartzer，意為更暗，她是黑森林的Lyn Alden，不丟棄任何東西。

2116880652389728748.en_summary: Elon Musk posts about maximizing for long-term unregretted user seconds, quoting Similarweb data that X led major social media in average visit duration in September 2026 at 13 minutes 25 seconds.
2116880652389728748.zh_summary: Elon Musk發文關於最大化長期無悔用戶秒數，引用Similarweb數據，X在2026年9月主要社交媒體平均訪問時長領先，為13分25秒。

2116875720337113339.en_summary: (Reposted by @elonmusk) Naval Ravikant once shared a story about Bill Gates shorting Tesla, a massive short position reportedly equivalent to roughly 1% of the company’s total shares that could cost him more than $10 billion if Tesla became the world’s most valuable company by a wide margin. Musk was confused how someone championing clean energy would financially bet against Tesla's mission to accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy. According to Naval, this revealed Musk is driven by mission, not money, using billions as tools to build rockets and make humanity multiplanetary.
2116875720337113339.zh_summary: (由@elonmusk轉推) Naval Ravikant曾分享Bill Gates做空特斯拉的故事，據報空頭倉位約佔公司總股份1%，如果特斯拉成為世界上最有價值的公司且大幅領先，可能使他損失超過100億美元。Musk感到困惑，一個公開支持清潔能源的人為何會財務上押注反對特斯拉加速世界向可持續能源轉型的使命。根據Naval，這揭示Musk由使命驅動而非金錢，將數十億用作建造火箭和使人類成為多行星物種的工具。

2116870936565858392.en_summary: Mr_Derivatives notes Elon Musk was X verified on December 1969, before Apple and Microsoft existed, joking about time travel, clarifying it's not fake or his DOB, and that he is trolling, needing to decode the significance of December 1969.
2116870936565858392.zh_summary: Mr_Derivatives指出Elon Musk在1969年12月獲得X驗證，早於蘋果和微軟存在，開玩笑說時間旅行，澄清不是假的也不是他的出生日期，他是在trolling，需要解碼1969年12月的意義。
